responsibility: Implements the Rust HIR unsafe-use checker. It traverses expressions, statements, and items while tracking nested unsafe contexts, uses name resolution, type-check context, and HIR mappings to identify references to mutable or extern statics, calls to unsafe functions or extern functions, and calls to functions requiring unsafe because of attributes such as #[target_feature], and emits diagnostics when those operations occur outside an unsafe block or unsafe function.
same_name_distinction: Provides the actual unsafe-checking traversal and diagnostics declared in the header, including the visit-method bodies, unsafe-context stack handling, resolver/type-check lookups, and checks for mutable or extern statics, unsafe calls, and #[target_feature] callees.
